```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, ggstatsplot, knitr)

all_nodes <- read_rds("data/rds/all_nodes.rds")
stations <- read_rds("data/rds/stations.rds")
mpsz <- read_rds("data/rds/mpsz.rds")
subzone_TA <- read_rds("data/rds/subzone_TA.rds")
stn_est <- read_rds("data/rds/stn_est.rds")
forecast <- read_rds("data/rds/forecast.rds")
model_table <- read_rds("data/rds/model_table.rds")
pred_table <- read_rds("data/rds/pred_table.rds")
dest_mix <- read_rds("data/rds/dest_mix.rds")
key <- read_rds("data/rds/key_numbers.rds")

fmt <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",")
new_fc <- forecast %>% filter(status == "Proposed")
n_jrl <- fmt(sum(new_fc$future[new_fc$new_line == "Jurong Region Line"]))
n_crl <- fmt(sum(new_fc$future[new_fc$new_line == "Cross Island Line"]))
n_lose20 <- sum(forecast$status == "Existing" & forecast$pct_change < -20)
lambda_hat <- round(key$lambda_hat, 2)
switched <- subzone_TA %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(switched)
share_switched <- round(sum(switched$P_CNT) / sum(subzone_TA$P_CNT) * 100)
```

## 1. Why this matters

::: {.stats}
::: {.stat}
[36]{.num} [new stations: JRL (24) and CRL Phase 1 (12)]{.label}
:::

::: {.stat}
[`r fmt(key$total_obs)`]{.num} [weekday morning (06:00–09:59) tap-ins per day, Sep 2026]{.label}
:::

::: {.stat}
[`r fmt(key$residents)`]{.num} [residents in `r key$n_origins` subzones]{.label}
:::
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.card}
[The problem]{.eyebrow}

Stations built ahead of demand can sit empty for years: Buangkok, Woodleigh and Hume stayed closed because projected ridership was too low. Planners need to know **how many riders** a new station will attract, and **from which existing stations** they will come.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="52%"}
::: {.card}
[Research question]{.eyebrow}

How many residents will start their morning trips at the proposed **JRL and CRL** stations, and how will these stations change the **ridership and market areas** of existing stations?
:::
:::
::::

## 2. Data and preparation

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Data]{.eyebrow}

| Dataset | Source |
|----|----|
| OD tap-ins by station, Sep 2026 | LTA DataMall API |
| Station polygons, codes, bus stops | LTA DataMall |
| Future station coordinates | URA Master Plan (GitHub) |
| Subzone boundaries (MP2019) | data.gov.sg (URA) |
| Population by subzone, 2025 | SingStat |
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Clearing the land mines]{.eyebrow}

-   Station layer: **no EPSG**, depots, unopened stations
-   **TEL/NEL polygons reuse old codes** → lines from code table
-   Code table predates **CCL6** → CC30–CC34 added
-   **184 station complexes**; 6 invalid subzones repaired
-   Cross-border bus stops removed; **200 m** distance floor
:::
:::
::::

## 3. Analytical approach

::: {.card}
| Step | Method (course reference) |
|----|----|
| Interaction data frames | 234 subzones × 184 stations (today), × 213 (future); **st_distance()** + **pivot_longer()** (Hands-on 8) |
| Huff model | $p_{ij} = A_j d_{ij}^{\lambda} / \sum_k A_k d_{ik}^{\lambda}$; market = residents × morning trip rate (`r round(key$trip_rate, 3)`) |
| Calibration | **huff.shares()** → **huff.lambda()** → **huff.fit()**; fit with **model.fit()** (Lesson 8) |
| Station attraction | Regression of log $A_j^*$ on lines, bus stops, LRT, distance to CBD; diagnostics, Moran's I, GWR (Hands-on 9) |
| Prediction | 75/25 train-test split; MLR vs **gwr.predict()** by RMSE (Hands-on 10) |
| Value-added | **MCI** destination choice with **mci.fit()** (Lesson 8) |
:::

## 4. Calibrating the Huff model

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 5.2
ggscatterstats(stn_est, x = est_fit, y = ridership,
               xlab = "Estimated AM tap-ins per day (M2)",
               ylab = "Observed AM tap-ins per day",
               marginal = FALSE, results.subtitle = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
::: {.card}
[Model comparison]{.eyebrow}

```{r}
model_table %>%
  transmute(Model = str_extract(model, "^M[0-9]"),
            `λ` = round(lambda, 2),
            `Pseudo-R²` = round(pseudo_R2, 2),
            `MAPE %` = round(MAPE)) %>%
  kable()
```

-   **M0** Hands-on 8 settings · **M1** huff.lambda() · **M2** huff.fit()
-   λ = `r lambda_hat`: a station twice as far is only **one-fifth** as attractive
-   Distance alone is not enough: station attraction lifts pseudo-R² from **0.43 to 0.96**
:::
:::
::::

## 5. What makes a station attractive

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Regression of log fitted attraction (R² = `r round(key$mlr_r2, 2)`)]{.eyebrow}

-   **Each extra line ×2.1** (p \< 0.001)
-   **Each extra bus stop** within 400 m **+4.5%** (p = 0.01)
-   **LRT-only station ×0.13** (p \< 0.001): residents go to the MRT hub
-   **Each km from the CBD +4.6%** (p \< 0.001)
-   VIF \< 1.3; residual Moran's I = 0.09 (p = 0.056)
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Predicting unseen stations (test set)]{.eyebrow}

```{r}
pred_table %>%
  rename(Model = model, `RMSE (log attraction)` = RMSE_log_attraction) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```

-   GWR is slightly better and is used for the 29 new stations
-   Bandwidth 116 of 184 stations: effects are **broadly the same island-wide**
-   Typical error ≈ a factor of 2 → read station forecasts as **approximate (±2×)**
:::
:::
::::

## 7. Impact on existing stations

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.2
impact_sf <- stations %>%
  select(stn_name) %>%
  left_join(forecast, by = "stn_name") %>%
  mutate(impact_class = cut(pct_change,
                            breaks = c(-Inf, -40, -20, -5, 5, Inf),
                            labels = c("loss > 40%", "loss 20-40%",
                                       "loss 5-20%", "within 5%", "gain > 5%")))
tm_shape(mpsz) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "grey97", col = "grey80", lwd = 0.3) +
tm_shape(all_nodes %>% filter(status == "Proposed")) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.25, shape = 24, fill = "white", col = "black") +
tm_shape(impact_sf) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.6,
          fill = "impact_class",
          fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
            values = c("#b2182b", "#ef8a62", "#fddbc7", "grey60", "#2166ac")),
          fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Change in AM tap-ins")) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
```
:::

::: {.column width="42%"}
::: {.card}
[Findings]{.eyebrow}

-   Median **−10%**; West median **−25%**; **`r n_lose20`** stations lose \>20%
-   **West EWL:** Pioneer −73%, Chinese Garden −63%, Lakeside −57%
-   **Gains:** Bright Hill +66%, Hougang +39%, Ang Mo Kio +32%
-   Lost tap-ins become **transfers**
:::
:::
::::

## 8. Market areas before and after

```{r}
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 5.6
west_box <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 8500, ymin = 32500, xmax = 23000, ymax = 42500),
                    crs = st_crs(3414))
west_TA <- subzone_TA %>% st_crop(west_box)
ta_levels <- sort(unique(c(west_TA$TA, west_TA$TA_future)))
ta_pal <- c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
            RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
            RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set1"),
            RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")) %>%
  setdiff(c("#666666", "#999999", "#D9D9D9"))
ta_pal <- ta_pal[seq_along(ta_levels)]
west_TA <- west_TA %>%
  mutate(TA = factor(TA, levels = ta_levels),
         TA_future = factor(TA_future, levels = ta_levels))
map_TA <- function(var, title, nodes) {
  tm_shape(west_TA, bbox = west_box) +
    tm_polygons(fill = var,
                fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = ta_pal,
                                                  levels.drop = FALSE),
                fill.legend = tm_legend_hide(),
                col = "white") +
  tm_shape(nodes %>% st_crop(west_box)) +
    tm_dots(size = 0.3, fill = "black") +
    tm_text("stn_name", size = 0.55, ymod = 0.7) +
  tm_title(title) +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE)
}
tmap_arrange(
  map_TA("TA", "Market areas today", all_nodes %>% filter(status == "Existing")),
  map_TA("TA_future", "Market areas with JRL", all_nodes),
  ncol = 2)
```

::: {.takeaway}
About **`r share_switched`% of residents (`r fmt(sum(switched$P_CNT))`)** get a new most likely station. In the west, Yunnan moves from Pioneer to **Gek Poh**, Boon Lay Place from Boon Lay to **Jurong West**, and Brickworks from Bukit Gombak to **Tengah Park**.
:::

## 9. Value-added: where will the riders go? (MCI)

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="60%"}
```{r}
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(dest_mix, aes(x = share, y = fct_rev(group), fill = dest_area)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = if_else(share >= 0.08, scales::percent(share, 1), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CBD" = "#d73027", "Other Central" = "#fc8d59",
                               "Jurong districts" = "#4575b4", "Other West" = "#91bfdb",
                               "North / North-East / East" = "#d9d9d9")) +
  labs(x = "Share of weekday morning trips", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
:::

::: {.column width="40%"}
::: {.card}
[MCI destination choice]{.eyebrow}

-   **mci.fit()** on 7,544 station × planning-area shares: mass **`r round(key$mci_coef[1], 2)`**, distance **`r round(key$mci_coef[2], 2)`**, R² `r round(key$mci_r2, 2)`
-   **JRL:** ~52% to central areas, ~31% stay west
-   **CRL:** ~60% to central areas
-   **Both lines are feeders** → transfer capacity at interchanges
:::
:::
::::

## 10. Limitations and implications

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Limitations]{.eyebrow}

-   Only **residents** modelled: industrial, campus, airport and CBD stations are under-predicted
-   **Fixed market**: no induced demand, so losses are overstated and gains understated
-   One point per **subzone**; **straight-line** distance; 2025 population
-   New-station attraction uncertain (test RMSE 0.76 on log scale); interchange line effect assumed
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.card}
[Implications for planning and public safety]{.eyebrow}

-   **Public safety:** all 7 new interchanges get **many more transfers** (Hougang, Ang Mo Kio and Bright Hill also more tap-ins) → check platform and escalator crowding
-   **Re-plan feeder buses** into Pioneer, Lakeside, Bukit Gombak and Tampines
-   **Phase weak stations** (Aviation Park, Peng Kang Hill, Jurong Pier) with job growth, to avoid "ghost stations"
:::
:::
::::
